Indus Analytics · Data Engineer Trainee (6-month program) · Karachi

Indus Analytics helps retail chains understand their sales. Our trainee program takes fresh graduates and turns them into data engineers.

Responsibilities
- Build and maintain ETL pipelines that load sales data into our data warehouse.
- Write SQL to clean, join and aggregate large tables.
- Schedule and monitor batch jobs with Apache Airflow.
- Write Python scripts to validate data quality.
- Work with analysts to understand what reports they need.

Requirements
- BS in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics or similar.
- Strong SQL skills.
- Basic Python.
- Understanding of relational database design.
- Curiosity about data and attention to detail.
